create.name: Detzi Simpson
create.bio:
Detzi Simpson is a Reiki teacher and shamanic practitioner in Mapperley, on the north-east side of Nottingham, where she runs The Peaceful Soul from a healing room in her home and from local community venues. She grew up in rural Suffolk with a strong sense of spirit around her, encouraged by a father who has spent decades exploring shamanism. Reiki came into her life in 2001 while she was working as an NHS speech and language therapist; after a profound experience during her Level 2 training she left the health service and opened The Peaceful Soul in 2016. She has since qualified as a Reiki Master Healer and Teacher in both Western and traditional Japanese lineages.

Her teaching centres on small groups. She runs Reiki courses from first degree through to master teacher, along with Shamanic Reiki and regular Reiki shares. Most Thursday evenings bring a class: relaxation and meditation nights with guided visualisation, breath and gentle movement; drumming circles timed to the old seasonal festivals such as Samhain and Beltane; and evenings on crystals, pendulums, oracle cards and creative practice. From time to time she and her father lead a day of making a shamanic drum. She also offers one-to-one shamanic sessions and spiritual development mentoring, and is building an online library of practices for students.

courses.title: Reiki Courses: Level 1 to Master Teacher
courses.description: Small-group or one-to-one Usui Reiki training in Mapperley, from a first-degree day with its attunement and self-practice, through the second (practitioner) level, to Master Healer and Master Teacher. Each level is usually taught as a one-day intensive with a manual and certificate, and case studies complete the higher levels.

courses.title: Healing Drum & Inspired Guided Meditation
courses.description: An evening drumming circle held around the old seasonal festivals, open to complete beginners. It mixes shamanic and free group drumming, an individual sound cleanse with drum and rattle for each person, and a closing guided meditation on the season's theme.

courses.title: Peaceful Me Relaxation & Meditation Evenings
courses.description: Themed Thursday classes of 60 to 90 minutes for a small group, designed to make meditation approachable. Sessions draw on guided visualisation, simple movement meditations and breathing practices, sometimes with a more spiritual focus and sometimes simply for rest.

courses.title: Drum Birthing Day Workshops
courses.description: A full day spent making your own shamanic frame drum with her father Peter, a long-time drum maker. The day includes cleansing and honouring the wood and hide, crafting the drum, and an optional shamanic journey to meet the spirit of the materials.

courses.title: Shamanic Healing Sessions
courses.description: One-to-one sessions in her healing room in which she opens sacred space, works with drum, rattle and other sound tools for an energy cleanse, and follows with guided journeying and other shamanic practices.

courses.title: Spiritual Development Mentoring
courses.description: Individual sessions shaped around a student's own path, which can include oracle and tarot reading, crystals and pendulums, working with spirit guides, energy protection, journeying and deepening a Reiki practice, with practices to take home.
